    // Six times the signed volume of the simplex (a, b, c, d): the scalar triple
    // product (b - a) x (c - a) . (d - a). Positive when d lies on the side of
    // triangle (a, b, c) its right-hand-rule normal points to. The orientation
    // predicate the containment test below is built from.
    SixTimesSignedVolume(a: Point3D, b: Point3D, c: Point3D, d: Point3D): Number
        => a.Between(b).Cross(a.Between(c)).Dot(a.Between(d));
